author: Linnaeus, 1758
summary: 겨울을 바다에서 나는 도요새로, 날씨가 궂으면 해안가에서도 보인다. 아이슬란드 서부와 시베리아에서 번식하고 아프리카와 남아메리카에서 겨울을 나며, 유럽은 이동 중에 거쳐 가는 곳이다.

art.subject: Red Phalarope (Phalaropus fulicarius), adult in winter (non-breeding) plumage, as seen at sea off Korea outside the breeding season: head white with a dark grey patch on the rear crown and a thick black patch through and behind the eye; hindneck grey; back and scapulars plain, unstreaked pale blue-grey; wings darker grey; underparts white; bill short and thick, black with a little yellowish at the base; dark eye; short grey legs with lobed toes, hidden while swimming.
art.pose: swimming on the sea surface, side view
art.scene: Korean winter sea off a rocky coast, grey choppy water; no people, buildings or text
views: adult winter, side view swimming: unstreaked pale grey back, white head with a black eye patch and grey rear crown, white underparts, short thick black bill with a yellowish base
adult female breeding, side view swimming: brick-red neck and underparts, black crown and forehead, large white cheek patch, blackish back with buff fringes, yellow bill with a black tip
adult winter, in flight seen from above: plain pale grey back, darker grey wings with a bold white wing-bar, dark-centred rump
art.build: Small, plump, short-necked wader that swims buoyantly high on the water like a tiny gull, about Dunlin-sized and slightly bulkier than Red-necked Phalarope. Bill short, straight, noticeably thick and broad, shorter than the head, with a blunt tip. Legs short, with lobed toes. Wings long and pointed; at rest the wingtips reach about the tail tip. In flight a bold white wing-bar on grey upperwings and a dark-centred rump and tail. Often spins on the water to stir up food.
avoid: Do not draw a needle-thin bill or a dark back with white stripes; those belong to Red-necked Phalarope (Phalaropus lobatus).
Do not show red underparts on a winter bird; red is breeding plumage only.
Do not paint the breeding head as black-and-white stripes; it is a black crown and face with a large white cheek patch.
Do not stand it on long legs; it floats high on the water.
